engine: MegaCapybara 1.39 (the running server, read with an instrumentation tool)
size_note: the model file (from the folder listing)
how: MegaCapybara returns no probabilities and its source is not published. A dynamic instrumentation tool (Frida) was attached to the running server process, and the logits of the whole vocabulary that the engine had computed on the GPU for the last position were read from it: one request per position (prompt = the window up to that position as token ids, one greedy token). No file of the program was changed.
